question: hashabiah-2 is recorded with more than one father: jeduthun, bunni-2.

actions.why: Separate Hashabiah the singer, explicitly under his father Jeduthun in 1CH 25:3 (row 99358), from Hashabiah son of Bunni and father of Azrikam in NEH 11:15 (rows 99359, 99360, 106478). Row 106044 belongs to the latter: 1CH 9:14 repeats the Shemaiah–Hashub–Azrikam–Hashabiah genealogy and identifies its Merarite ancestry.

note: The contradiction results from combining two namesakes in hashabiah-2. Preserve the project owner's rulings; neither requires alteration to separate these identities.
